games.name: Suds & Duds Laundromat
games.description: Run the corner laundromat! Click the sorting table to wash loads, then step on glowing pads to buy washers, dryers, a vending machine and more. Knock down the wall to expand into the Dry-Cleaning Wing and light up the Grand Reopening sign. A cozy tycoon by gooberr478.
games.creator: gooberr478

games.name: Midnight at Maple Mall
games.description: You fell asleep in the beanbag aisle and the mall locked up for the night! Explore the Toy Kingdom, Pet Paradise, Arcade, Cinema and Food Court, find 6 security keycards, hunt 24 lost coins and 3 secret golden ducks, then unlock the Loading Dock and escape before morning. An after-hours adventure by gooberr478.
games.creator: gooberr478
